allytips: Tentacles are an immense source of power. Don't fight without them.
Spirits inherit their target's current health. If making a
Vessel
is your goal, try whittling your opponent's health down a bit first to make killing the spirit easier.
Leap of Faith is best used to follow-up a strong engage or when being engaged upon. Be careful about being the first one into a fight.
enemytips: Killing Tentacles whenever possible will make it much easier to win a fight against Illaoi.
When your spirit gets pulled out, fight back if you can. Dealing damage to Illaoi reduces the spirit's duration.
Avoid grouping up for Leap of Faith to reduce the number of Tentacles available to Illaoi.

champions.name: Rek'Sai
champions.title: the Void Burrower
champions.lore: An apex predator, Rek'Sai is a merciless Void-spawn that tunnels beneath the ground to ambush and devour unsuspecting prey. Her insatiable hunger has laid waste to entire regions of the once-great empire of Shurima—merchants, traders, even armed caravans, will go hundreds of miles out of their way to avoid her and her offspring's hunting grounds. All know that once Rek'Sai is seen on the horizon, death from below is all but guaranteed.

spells.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
spells.description:
Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.
spells.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within {{ buffduration }} seconds gain <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and deal an additional <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
spells.description:
Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains <speed>{{ burrowedmovespeed }} Move Speed</speed>, {{ visionradiusmod*-100 }}% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
spells.description:
Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.

While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.
spells.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Unburrowed:</keywordMajor> Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ spell.reksaie:basedamagecalculation }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. At max <keywordMajor>Fury</keywordMajor>, the bite deals <trueDamage>{{ spell.reksaie:empowereddamagecalculation }} true damage</trueDamage> instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Void Rush
spells.description: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.
spells.tooltip: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last {{ preymarkduration }} seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ rbasedamagecalc }} plus {{ percenthealthdamage }}% max Health physical damage</physicalDamage> and resets the cooldown of <keywordMajor>Burrow / Un-burrow</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

champions.name: Ivern
champions.title: the Green Father
champions.lore: Ivern Bramblefoot, known to many as the Green Father, is a peculiar half man, half tree who roams Runeterra's forests, cultivating life everywhere he goes. He knows the secrets of the natural world, and holds deep friendships with all things that grow, fly, and scuttle. Ivern wanders the wilderness, imparting strange wisdom to any he meets, enriching the forests, and occasionally entrusting loose-lipped butterflies with his secrets.

spells.name: Rootcaller
spells.description: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.
spells.tooltip:
Ivern conjures a vine dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range.

Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy.

Hitting non-epic monsters reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Brushmaker
spells.description: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: While in brush and for {{ buffduration }} seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for {{ allybuffduration }} seconds and deal {{ totalallydamage }} magic damage.

Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for {{ revealduration }} seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to {{ maxbrushduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Triggerseed
spells.description: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.
spells.tooltip:

source.name: Ivern
source.title: the Green Father
source.shortBio: Ivern Bramblefoot, known to many as the Green Father, is a peculiar half man, half tree who roams Runeterra's forests, cultivating life everywhere he goes. He knows the secrets of the natural world, and holds deep friendships with all things that grow, fly, and scuttle. Ivern wanders the wilderness, imparting strange wisdom to any he meets, enriching the forests, and occasionally entrusting loose-lipped butterflies with his secrets.

champions.name: Kalista
champions.title: the Spear of Vengeance
champions.lore: A specter of wrath and retribution, Kalista is the undying spirit of vengeance, an armored nightmare summoned from the Shadow Isles to hunt deceivers and traitors. The betrayed may cry out in blood to be avenged, but Kalista only answers those willing to pay with their very souls. Those who become the focus of Kalista's wrath should make their final peace, for any pact sealed with this grim hunter can only end with the cold, piercing fire of her soul-spears.

spells.name: Pierce
spells.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.
spells.tooltip:
Kalista hurls a spear, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any Rend stacks to the next target hit.

Kalista can dash after using this Ability using Martial Poise.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Sentinel
spells.description:

Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetooltip }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rend

Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing {{ normaldamage }} plus {{ additionaldamage }} physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by {{ totalslowamount }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds {{ manarefund }} Mana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allytips: Rend is a valuable last hitting aid, since its cooldown resets if it kills a target.
Entering a move order once to trigger Martial Poise will not clear Kalista's basic attack target.
Due to her passive, Kalista's Move Speed is effectively increased by Attack Speed.
enemytips: Kalista's mobility is dependent upon attacking. This means it is low when she is outside of her attack range and that Attack Speed slows reduce the amount of distance she can cover in an engagement.
Kalista cannot cancel her basic attack wind up. While she is very mobile, this offers a window to land spells on her if you anticipate when she will begin attacking.
If you can break line of sight from Kalista, including through brush, her basic attacks will miss you, falling harmlessly to the ground.

champions.name: Bard
champions.title: the Wandering Caretaker
champions.lore: A traveler from beyond the stars, Bard is an agent of serendipity who fights to maintain a balance where life can endure the indifference of chaos. Many Runeterrans sing songs that ponder his extraordinary nature, yet they all agree that the cosmic vagabond is drawn to artifacts of great magical power. Surrounded by a jubilant choir of helpful spirit meeps, it is impossible to mistake his actions as malevolent, as Bard always serves the greater good... in his own odd way.

If the bolt hits a second enemy or a wall, any enemies hit are Stunned for {{ stunduration }}s.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Bard can have up to {{ maxpacks }} shrines at once. If an enemy champion enters a shrine, it is destroyed.

This ability has {{ ammo_limit }} charges.

Few would suspect this energetic, traveling showman is also partner to the rebel Xayah, and is dedicated to her cause.

source.name: Rakan
source.title: The Charmer
source.shortBio: As mercurial as he is charming, Rakan is an infamous vastayan troublemaker and the greatest battle-dancer in Lhotlan tribal history. To the humans of the Ionian highlands, his name has long been synonymous with wild festivals, uncontrollable parties, and anarchic music. Few would suspect this energetic, traveling showman is also partner to the rebel Xayah, and is dedicated to her cause.

skins.name: Cosmic Dawn Rakan
skins.description: Dawn chases dusk beneath the sea, two lovers locked in an endless waltz across the stars. Thus Rakan is never far behind Xayah, his breaking light glowing always above her shadow.

skins.name: Sweetheart Rakan
skins.description: Love is in the air, and this time Rakan has a plan. He swears, this time, it will definitely, almost absolutely certainly happen. He's thought about every poetic phrase, every dreamy dance move—but still, he can't decide on what the perfect gift would be: chocolates, or flowers?

champions.name: Ornn
champions.title: The Fire below the Mountain
champions.lore: Ornn is the Freljordian spirit of forging and craftsmanship. He works in the solitude of a massive smithy, hammered out from the lava caverns beneath the volcano Hearth-Home. There he stokes bubbling cauldrons of molten rock to purify ores and fashion items of unsurpassed quality. When other deities—especially Volibear—walk the earth and meddle in mortal affairs, Ornn arises to put these impetuous beings back in their place, either with his trusty hammer or the fiery power of the mountains themselves.

champions.blurb: Ornn is the Freljordian spirit of forging and craftsmanship. He works in the solitude of a massive smithy, hammered out from the lava caverns beneath the volcano Hearth-Home. There he stokes bubbling cauldrons of molten rock to purify ores and fashion...

Volcanic Rupture can be used to set up zoning areas to threaten enemies.
The order of your abilties matters! Try to optimize Brittle usage.

champions.name: Sylas
champions.title: the Unshackled
champions.lore: Raised in one of Demacia's lesser quarters, Sylas of Dregbourne has come to symbolize the darker side of the Great City. As a boy, his ability to root out hidden sorcery caught the attention of the notorious mageseekers, who eventually imprisoned him for turning those same powers against them. Having now broken free, Sylas lives as a hardened revolutionary, using the magic of those around him to destroy the kingdom he once served… and his band of outcast mage followers seems to grow by the day.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.description:
Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies.

After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.
spells.tooltip: Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowamountcalc }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further <magicDamage>{{ explosiondamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.
spells.tooltip: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Against champions, Sylas restores between <healing>{{ minhealing }}</healing> and <healing>{{ maxhealing }} Health</healing> based on his missing Health (max healing at or below {{ maxexecutethreshold*100 }}% Health).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.description: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage, and Knocking Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hijack
spells.description: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.
spells.tooltip:

Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for {{ pertargetcooldown }}% (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of {{ minimumenemycooldown }} seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

With every step he takes, he remembers what others have branded him: Mage, Traitor, Kingslayer—names he revels in as he endures the bitter cold, his heart warmed by the fires of rebellion. champions.name: Neeko
champions.title: the Curious Chameleon
champions.lore: Hailing from a long lost tribe of vastaya, Neeko can blend into any crowd by borrowing the appearances of others, even absorbing something of their emotional state to tell friend from foe in an instant. No one is ever sure where—or who—Neeko might be, but those who intend to do her harm will soon witness her true colors revealed, and feel the full power of her primordial spirit magic unleashed upon them.

spells.name: Blooming Burst
spells.description: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.
spells.tooltip: Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal <magicDamage>{{ explosiondamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing <magicDamage>{{ seconddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Max 2 extra blooms.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shapesplitter
spells.description: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional {{ passivebonusdamagecalc }} bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by {{ passivehaste }}% for {{ passivehasteduration }} second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for {{ stealthduration }} seconds and projects a clone that lasts {{ cloneduration }} seconds. Neeko and the clone gain {{ haste }}% Move Speed for {{ hasteduration }} seconds.

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tangle-Barbs
spells.description: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.
spells.tooltip:
Neeko slings a tangle that deals {{ basedamage }} magic damage and Roots for {{ minrootduration }} seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for {{ maxrootduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Pop Blossom
spells.description: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.

champions.name: Aphelios
champions.title: the Weapon of the Faithful
champions.lore: Emerging from moonlight's shadow with weapons drawn, Aphelios kills the enemies of his faith in brooding silence—speaking only through the certainty of his aim, and the firing of each gun. Though fueled by a poison that renders him mute, he is guided by his sister Alune. From her distant temple sanctuary, she pushes an arsenal of moonstone weapons into his hands. For as long as the moon shines overhead, Aphelios will never be alone.

Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.
Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.
Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.
Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.
Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

champions.name: Rell
champions.title: the Iron Maiden
champions.lore: The product of brutal experimentation at the hands of the Black Rose, Rell is a defiant, living weapon determined to topple Noxus. Her childhood was one of misery and horror, enduring unspeakable procedures to perfect and weaponize her magical control over metal... until she staged a violent escape, killing many of her captors in the process. Now branded as a criminal, Rell attacks Noxian soldiers on sight as she searches for survivors of her old “academy,” defending the meek while delivering violent death to her former overseers.

spells.name: Shattering Strike
spells.description: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

champions.name: Pyke

champions.lore: A renowned harpooner from the slaughter docks of Bilgewater, Pyke should have met his death in the belly of a gigantic jaull-fish… and yet, he returned. Now, stalking the dank alleys and backways of his former hometown, he uses his new supernatural gifts to bring a swift and gruesome end to those who make their fortune by exploiting others—and a city that prides itself on hunting monsters now finds a monster hunting them.

spells.name: Bone Skewer
spells.description: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.
spells.tooltip:
Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.

Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.

If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, {{ manarefund*100 }}% of the Mana cost is refunded.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allytips: Pyke is very fragile so don't be afraid to temporarily run from a fight. You can regenerate a significant amount of health from Gift of the Drowned Ones when enemies can't see you.
Hitting an enemy with the Hold version of Bone Skewer will always pull them the same distance. Use it in melee range to throw targets behind you.
The Tap version of Bone Skewer is much faster and deals additional damage.
A lot of your agressive spells are also your escapes. Make sure you always have a plan to get out of the fight.
enemytips: Pyke regenerates a significant amount of damage he has taken from enemy champions, but only when you can't see him!
When Pyke is hidden nearby in his Ghostwater Dive, sharks will circle underneath your feet.
Try not to stand near low health allies. If Pyke executes them using Death From Below, you might be next on the list.

champions.name: Vex
champions.title: the Gloomist
champions.lore: In the black heart of the Shadow Isles, a lone yordle trudges through the spectral fog, content in its murky misery. With an endless supply of teen angst and a powerful shadow in tow, Vex lives in her own self-made slice of gloom, far from the revolting cheer of the “normie” world. Though she lacks ambition, she is quick to strike down color and happiness, stopping all would-be interlopers with her magical malaise.

source.name: Vex
source.title: the Gloomist
source.shortBio: In the black heart of the Shadow Isles, a lone yordle trudges through the spectral fog, content in its murky misery. With an endless supply of teen angst and a powerful shadow in tow, Vex lives in her own self-made slice of gloom, far from the revolting cheer of the “normie” world. Though she lacks ambition, she is quick to strike down color and happiness, stopping all would-be interlopers with her magical malaise.

champions.title: the Unforgotten
champions.lore: In life, he was Yone—half-brother of Yasuo, and renowned student of his village's sword school. But upon his death at the hands of his brother, he found himself hunted by a malevolent entity of the spirit realm, and was forced to slay it with its own sword. Now, cursed to wear its demonic mask upon his face, Yone tirelessly hunts all such creatures in order to understand what he has become.

Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

champions.name: Ambessa
champions.title: Matriarch of War
champions.lore: All who know the name Medarda respect and fear the family's leader, Ambessa. As a Noxian general, she embodies a deadly combination of ruthless strength and fearless resolve in battle. Her role as matriarch is no different, requiring great cunning to empower the Medardas while leaving no room for failure or compassion. Embracing the merciless ways of the Wolf, Ambessa will do whatever it takes to protect her family's legacy, even at the cost of her own children's love.

spells.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
spells.description: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

Sundering Slam: Ambessa slams her blades down, dealing {{ calc_damage_2_max }} + {{ calc_damage_2_percent_max }} max Health physical damage against the first enemy hit. All other enemies take {{ calc_damage_2_min_ratio }} damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

champions.name: Mel
champions.title: the Soul's Reflection
champions.lore: Mel Medarda is the presumed heir of the Medarda family, once one of the most powerful in Noxus. In appearance she is a graceful aristocrat, but beneath the surface lies a skilled politician who makes it her business to know everything about everyone she meets. After an encounter with the mysterious Black Rose, Mel discovered the depths of her mother's deception and, for once, faced a situation potentially beyond her control. With newly awakened magical abilities, she sailed home in search of answers—and though many still seek to temper the light within her, Mel's soul remains forever defiant.

source.name: Mel
source.title: the Soul's Reflection
source.shortBio: Mel Medarda is the presumed heir of the Medarda family, once one of the most powerful in Noxus. In appearance she is a graceful aristocrat, but beneath the surface lies a skilled politician who makes it her business to know everything about everyone she meets. After an encounter with the mysterious Black Rose, Mel discovered the depths of her mother's deception and, for once, faced a situation potentially beyond her control. With newly awakened magical abilities, she sailed home in search of answers—and though many still seek to temper the light within her, Mel's soul remains forever defiant.

champions.title: the Unbroken Faith
champions.lore: Unwavering in her devotion to Ionia, Yunara has spent centuries cloistered away in the spirit realm honing her skills with the Aion Er'na, a legendary Kinkou relic. Despite all she has sacrificed, Yunara's vow to rid the land of disharmony and strife remains unbroken, as does her faith. But the world that now awaits her—and the shadow of an ancient threat risen once more—will test every ounce of her resolve.

champions.name: Locke
champions.title: the Ashen Exorcist
champions.lore: A nail-slinging exorcist versed in forbidden rites, Corvin Locke is the progeny of Demacian occultists. Born into lies and hypocrisy, he learned young that demons aren't the cause of humanity's darkness, but the consequence. Now, Locke tears through every soul, exposing its darkness, intent on making the world a more honest place… one exorcism at a time.

spells.description: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.
spells.tooltip:

Nails apply a {{ slowamount1*100 }}/{{ slowamount2*100 }}/{{ slowamount3*100 }}% Slow for {{ slowduration1 }}/{{ slowduration2 }}/{{ slowduration3 }} seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit.

Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails, dealing {{ naildamage }} magic damage per stack, increased by {{ twomarkbonuspercent }}% and {{ threemarkbonuspercent }}% for two and three nails respectively.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Ignition
spells.description: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
spells.tooltip:
Locke ignites his own soul, gaining {{ attackspeed }} Attack Speed and {{ movespeed }} Move Speed that decays over {{ decaytimehelper }} seconds.

For {{ baseduration }} seconds, he suffers {{ healthcost*100 }}% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last {{ damagerestoreamount }} damage taken, and an additional {{ additionalheal }} Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of {{ maxhealingthreshold }} Health remaining.

Can be Recast to end early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Though he began as a humble challenger in the fighting pits of Navori, he quickly gained notoriety for his savage strength, and his ability to take seemingly endless amounts of punishment. The Obsidian Dragon took notice of his grit and ferocity and blessed him with obsidian-hardened skin. Sett now uses his superhuman strength to make a name for himself as a pit fighter, and every hit that bounces off his crystalline skin makes his enemies tremble.

champions.name: Lillia
champions.title: the Bashful Bloom
champions.lore: Intensely shy, the fae fawn Lillia skittishly wanders Ionia's forests. Hiding just out of sight of mortals—whose mysterious natures have long captivated, but intimidated, her—Lillia hopes to discover why their dreams no longer reach the ancient Dreaming Tree. She now travels Ionia with a magical branch in hand, in an effort to find people's unrealized dreams. Only then can Lillia herself bloom and help others untangle their fears to find the sparkle within. Eep!

spells.description: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

champions.name: Gwen
champions.title: The Hallowed Seamstress
champions.lore: A former doll transformed and brought to life by magic, Gwen wields the very tools that once created her. She carries the weight of her maker's love with every step, taking nothing for granted. At her command is the Hallowed Mist, an ancient and protective magic that has blessed Gwen's scissors, needles, and sewing thread. So much is new to her, but Gwen remains joyfully determined to fight for the good that survives in a broken world.

spells.name: Snip Snip!
spells.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts {{ buffduration }} seconds).

Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for {{ miniswipedamage }} magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for {{ finalswipedamage }} magic damage.

The center of each strikes converts {{ truedamageconversion*100 }}% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit.

Deals {{ minionmod*100 }}% damage to minions.
Minions below {{ executethreshold*100 }}% health take {{ executebonus }}% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hallowed Mist
spells.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.
spells.tooltip:
Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for {{ zoneduration }} seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains {{ totalresists }} Armor and Magic Resist.

Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Skip 'n Slash
spells.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.
spells.tooltip:
Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for {{ buffduration }} seconds.

Empowered Attacks gain {{ bonusattackspeed }} Attack Speed, {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit, {{ bonusattackrange }} range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds {{ cdrefund*100 }}% of this Ability's Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Needlework
spells.description:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.
spells.tooltip:

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal {{ totaldamage3 }} magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal {{ totaldamage5 }} magic damage{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allytips: Always be Attacking - In addition to dealing bonus damage, Gwen's Attacks empower or reset many of her Abilities.
Gwen can still damage enemies outside her Hallowed Mists, especially with her Ultimate's range.
Some of Gwen's Abilities can apply her passive to multiple enemies, so aim them at groups to get maximum damage and healing.
enemytips: Gwen's Hallowed Mist shroud will only follow her once, after that it will dissipate when she leaves.
Gwen must hit something to recast her Ultimate, try to evade her between casts.
Gwen needs to attack a few times to set up her damage, so try to get the jump on her.

champions.name: Renata Glasc
champions.title: the Chem-Baroness
champions.lore: Renata Glasc rose from the ashes of her childhood home with nothing but her name and her parents' alchemical research. In the decades since, she has become Zaun's wealthiest chem-baron, a business magnate who built her power by tying everyone's interests to her own. Work with her, and be rewarded beyond measure. Work against her, and live to regret it. But everyone comes to her side, eventually.

spells.name: Handshake
spells.description: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.
spells.tooltip:
Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} second and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bailout
spells.description: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.
spells.tooltip:
Renata infuses an ally champion, granting {{ ascalc }} Attack Speed and {{ mscalc }} Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to {{ finalascalc }} Attack Speed and {{ finalmscalc }} Move Speed over {{ duration }} seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff.

If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds.

If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to {{ triumphpercent }}% max Health and stop decaying.

The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Loyalty Program

source.name: Renata Glasc
source.title: the Chem-Baroness
source.shortBio: Renata Glasc rose from the ashes of her childhood home with nothing but her name and her parents' alchemical research. In the decades since, she has become Zaun's wealthiest chem-baron, a business magnate who built her power by tying everyone's interests to her own. Work with her, and be rewarded beyond measure. Work against her, and live to regret it. But everyone comes to her side, eventually.

skins.description: Ambitious, cunning, cutthroat – these qualities served Admiral Glasc well during the Galactic Civil War. They serve her still, both on the front lines and in the weapons manufacturing industry. As leader of the Royal Space Military's R&D unit, Admiral Glasc will bring order to the galaxy with a firepower unmatched: whether it's dropping planetside or traversing distant stars, the universe is her chessboard, and she is the queen.

skins.description: In a life filled with forced relationships, death freed Renata to form the family she always wanted. As the Enterprise Family's founder, the bond between members doesn't come from any sense of familial warmth but from honest calculation. As for her work, Renata looks at society and pulls whatever deathly strings she needs to make things more “efficient.”

skins.description: From fashion model to maven, Renata owns one of the largest fashion houses showing at the Gala. After all this time, enough critics have declared her "death" after a poor show that she wears the label proudly, invigorating the spirit of her company and makeshift family. In the end, only she controls the threads of life and death, on the runway at least.

skins.name: Masque of the Black Rose Renata Glasc
skins.description: To the esteemed Renata Glasc, the noble houses of Noxus invite you to our nation as a guest at the Silken Danse. Here, we gather enterprising minds—for Noxus enters a new era in leadership, and we must forge new bonds accordingly. Let us learn of your blossoming influence in Zaun and the City of Progress, and how it may grow ever further. –Lady Elise

champions.name: Aurora
champions.title: the Witch Between Worlds
champions.lore: From the moment she was born, Aurora navigated life with a unique ability to move between the spirit and material realms. Determined to learn more about the spirit realm's inhabitants, she left her home to further her research and happened upon a wayward demigod who'd become twisted and lost to time. Witnessing his desperation, Aurora resolved to find a way to help her feral friend regain his forgotten identity—a journey that would take her to the farthest reaches of the Freljord.

spells.name: Twofold Hex
spells.description: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.
spells.tooltip:
Fire cursed energy in a direction, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage to enemies and cursing them for {{ markduration }} seconds.

Recast: End the curse, drawing back part of the enemy's spirit to Aurora, dealing up to {{ q2damagemax }} magic damage to enemies passed through based on their missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%.

If the duration runs out, Aurora will automatically Recast the Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Across the Veil
spells.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.
spells.tooltip:
Hop in a direction. Upon landing, enter the spirit realm, becoming Invisible for {{ invisduration }} seconds and entering Realm Hopper, gaining {{ movespeedbonus }}% Move Speed.

Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this Ability's Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Weirding
spells.description: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.
spells.tooltip:
Converge the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic dealing {{ damagecalc }} magic damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} second.

Aurora hops backwards a short distance after casting.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Between Worlds
spells.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.
spells.tooltip:
Leap in a direction. Upon landing, Aurora converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and Slows enemies hit by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% for 2 seconds.

The area of convergence stays active for {{ areaduration }} seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper for {{ areaduration }} seconds, allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another.

Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are Slowed by {{ exitslowpercent*-100 }}% for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

Aurora can Recast this Ability to end the effect early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

champions.name: Nilah
champions.title: the Joy Unbound
champions.lore: Nilah is an ascetic warrior from a distant land, seeking the world's deadliest, most titanic opponents so that she might challenge and destroy them. Having won her power through an encounter with the long-imprisoned demon of joy, she has no emotions other than unceasing jubilation—a small price to pay for the vast strength she now possesses. Channeling the demon's liquid form into a blade of unparalleled might, she stands defiant against ancient threats long forgotten.

spells.name: Formless Blade
spells.description: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Nilah gains {{ critarmorpen }} Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore {{ critlifesteal }} damage dealt as Health. Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and {{ bonusattackspeedcalc }}% Attack Speed, and her Attacks hit in a cone for {{ buffduration }} seconds.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Jubilant Veil
spells.description: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.
spells.tooltip:
Nilah envelops herself in mist for {{ baseduration }} seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining {{ movespeedpercent*100 }}% Move Speed, dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by {{ magicdamagereduction*100 }}%.

While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for {{ sharebaseduration }} seconds.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Slipstream
spells.description: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.
spells.tooltip: Nilah dashes through a unit, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ dashdamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to any enemies she passes through.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Apotheosis
spells.description: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.
spells.tooltip:
Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing {{ damagepertickcalctooltip }} physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of {{ damagecalc }} physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her.

Apotheosis heals Nilah and her nearby allies for {{ champhealingpercent }} (+{{ spell.nilahq:critlifesteal }} Formless Blade) of the damage dealt to enemy champions, converting any overhealing into a Shield for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

champions.name: K'Sante
champions.title: the Pride of Nazumah
champions.lore: Defiant and courageous, K'Sante battles colossal beasts and ruthless Ascended to protect his home of Nazumah, a coveted oasis amid the sands of Shurima. But after a falling-out with his former partner, K'Sante realizes that in order to become a warrior worthy of leading his city, he must temper his single-minded drive for success. Only then can he avoid falling prey to his own pride and find the wisdom he needs to defeat the vicious monsters threatening his people.

spells.name: Ntofo Strikes
spells.description:
K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.

On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for {{ recastwindow }} seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for {{ stunduration }} second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by {{ rcooldownreduction.0*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Path Maker
spells.description:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for {{ mindurationtooltip }}-{{ maxduration.1 }}s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by {{ damagereduction*100 }}%. Then, he rams forward, dealing {{ basedamage }} + {{ totalmaxhealthdamage }} max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for {{ minknockbackduration }}-{{ maxknockbackduration }}s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional {{ rdamageincreasemin*100 }}-{{ rdamageincreasemax*100 }}% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to {{ rdamagereduction*100 }}% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Footwork
spells.description:
K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante dashes, gaining {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by {{ cooldownmodao*100 }}% and dash speed is increased.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: All Out
spells.description: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
spells.tooltip:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for {{ alloutduration }}s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for {{ totaldamageslamdown }} physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed, {{ armorpenpercent*100 }}% Bonus Armor Penetration, and {{ omnivamp*100 }}% Omnivamp, but loses {{ healthlost*100 }}% max Health, {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Armor, and {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Magic Resistance.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

source.name: K'Sante
source.title: the Pride of Nazumah
source.shortBio: Defiant and courageous, K'Sante battles colossal beasts and ruthless Ascended to protect his home of Nazumah, a coveted oasis amid the sands of Shurima. But after a falling-out with his former partner, K'Sante realizes that in order to become a warrior worthy of leading his city, he must temper his single-minded drive for success. Only then can he avoid falling prey to his own pride and find the wisdom he needs to defeat the vicious monsters threatening his people.

champions.name: Milio
champions.title: The Gentle Flame
champions.lore: Milio is a warmhearted boy from Ixtal who has, despite his young age, mastered the fire axiom and discovered something new: soothing fire. With this newfound power, Milio plans to help his family escape their exile by joining the Yun Tal—just like his grandmother once did. Having traveled through the Ixtal jungles to the capital of Ixaocan, Milio now prepares to face the Vidalion and join the Yun Tal, unaware of the trials—and dangers—that await him.

champions.name: Hwei
champions.title: the Visionary
champions.lore: Hwei is a brooding painter who creates brilliant art in order to confront Ionia's criminals and comfort their victims. Beneath his melancholy roils a torn, emotional mind—haunted by both the vibrant visions of his imagination and the gruesome memories of his temple's massacre. Hwei seeks to understand this light and dark, which drives him inevitably toward the artist who unraveled him. With paintbrush and palette, Hwei shapes endless possibilities as he draws ever closer to earning closure or embracing despair.

spells.name: Subject: Disaster
spells.description:
Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.
spells.tooltip:

Devastating Fire
Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ tooltip_qqdamage }} plus {{ tooltip_qqbonusdamage }}% max health magic damage.

Severing Bolt
Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing {{ tooltip_qwdamage }} magic damage. Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to {{ tooltip_qwbonusdamage }} magic damage, based on the target's missing health.

Molten Fissure
Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing {{ tooltip_qedamage }} magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by {{ spell.hweiqe:slowpercent }}% and deal {{ tooltip_qedamagepersecond }} magic damage per second for {{ spell.hweiqe:duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Subject: Serenity

Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.
spells.tooltip:
Hwei paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions.

Fleeting Current
Hwei launches a current of swift waters in a line that grants allies {{ tooltip_wqmovespeed }} Move Speed.

Pool of Reflection
Hwei forms a protective pool that grants {{ tooltip_wwshieldamount }} Shields over time to allied champions inside reduced by {{ spell.hweiww:tooltipallymod*100 }}% for allies.

spells.name: Subject: Torment
spells.description:
Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.
spells.tooltip:
Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies.

Grim Visage
Hwei launches a terrifying face that causes the first enemy hit to Flee for {{ tooltip_eqfleeduration }} second(s) and take {{ tooltip_eqdamage }} magic damage.

Gaze of the Abyss
Hwei forms an eye that lingers and provides vision locking onto the first enemy champion that enters and launching a homing missile that Roots the first enemy hit for {{ tooltip_ewrootduration }} seconds dealing {{ tooltip_ewdamage }} magic damage.

Crushing Maw
Hwei paints a set of jaws at a target location that Drags enemies to the center dealing {{ tooltip_eedamage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies caught by {{ tooltip_eeslowamount }}% decaying over 1.25 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spiraling Despair
spells.description: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.
spells.tooltip:
Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for {{ duration }} seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for {{ slowpercentperstack }}% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing {{ damageovertime }} magic damage per second.

Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Subject: Disaster
spells.description:
Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.
spells.dynamicDescription:
Hwei paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies.

Devastating Fire
Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @Tooltip_QQDamage@ plus @Tooltip_QQBonusDamage@% max health magic damage.

Severing Bolt
Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing @Tooltip_QWDamage@ magic damage. Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to @Tooltip_QWBonusDamage@ magic damage, based on the target's missing health.

Molten Fissure
Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing @Tooltip_QEDamage@ magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by @spell.HweiQE:SlowPercent@% and deal @Tooltip_QEDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second for @spell.HweiQE:Duration@ seconds.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Subject: Serenity
spells.description:
Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings.

This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.
spells.dynamicDescription:
Hwei paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions.

Fleeting Current
Hwei launches a current of swift waters in a line that grants allies @Tooltip_WQMoveSpeed@ Move Speed.

Pool of Reflection
Hwei forms a protective pool that grants @Tooltip_WWShieldAmount@ Shields over time to allied champions inside reduced by @spell.HweiWW:ToolTipAllyMod*100@% for allies.

Stirring Lights
Hwei creates three swirling lights that empower his next three Abilities or Attacks to deal an additional @Tooltip_WEOnHitDamage@ magic damage and restore @Tooltip_WEOnHitManaRestore@ Mana each.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

source.name: Hwei
source.title: the Visionary
source.shortBio: Hwei is a brooding painter who creates brilliant art in order to confront Ionia's criminals and comfort their victims. Beneath his melancholy roils a torn, emotional mind—haunted by both the vibrant visions of his imagination and the gruesome memories of his temple's massacre. Hwei seeks to understand this light and dark, which drives him inevitably toward the artist who unraveled him. With paintbrush and palette, Hwei shapes endless possibilities as he draws ever closer to earning closure or embracing despair.

skins.description: The herald of Polaris, Hwei, waited in a despondent mood. When Senna and Hecarim found him among the world of man, a violent blizzard raged overhead. As herald, he used his brush to paint the Aurora across the skies, bringing the first snow. At Hecarim's beckoning, he waved his brush, parting the clouds to reveal a barren sky. Where was the Aurora?

skins.description: It is said, the Artist roams—obsessed with the soul's liminal space, where light and dark collide. He wields kanmei and akana essence to reveal the heart of those he paints. Chancing upon a divine temple, he painted its guardian Archer. But the portrait twisted into pure rage—a lesson to be true to oneself, lest the Artist expose what lies beneath.

skins.name: Sinful Shores Hwei
skins.description: Though usually found deep in the underworld, Hwei was “persuaded” to try brooding on the beach instead. Seeing mortals flee in broad daylight has indeed inspired new ideas for blissful torment. When beachgoers think they're safe in the sun, Hwei blots it out with dark clouds and wrathful waves to dampen their spirits for good.

champions.name: Naafiri
champions.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites
champions.lore: Across the sands of Shurima, a chorus of howls rings out. It is the call of the dune hounds, voracious predators who form packs and compete for the right to hunt in these barren lands. Among them, one pack stands above all, for they are driven not only by canine instincts, but by the ancient power of the Darkin.

spells.name: Darkin Daggers
spells.description:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.
spells.tooltip:
Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totaldamagefirstcast }} physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totalbleeddamage }} physical damage over {{ spell.naafiriq:bleedduration }} seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmindamagesecondcast }} and {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmaxdamagesecondcast }} physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores {{ spell.naafiriq:totalhealsecondcast }} Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for {{ spell.naafirip:packmatetauntduration }} seconds.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Call of the Pack
spells.description: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
spells.tooltip:
Naafiri becomes Untargetable for {{ untargetableduration }} second and prepares to hunt, spawning {{ packmatestoadd }} additional Packmates and gaining {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ duration }} seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Eviscerate
spells.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.
spells.tooltip:
Naafiri surges forward, dealing {{ totaldamagefirstslash }} physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing {{ totaldamagesecondslash }} physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hounds' Pursuit
spells.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.
spells.tooltip:
Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing {{ packmatedamage }} physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within {{ takedownwindow }} seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants {{ shieldtotal }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.


{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

perks.shortDesc: Start the game with 40 bonus health. When you get 4 takedowns, convert that health for an <lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword key='LinkTooltip_Description_Adaptive'><font color='#48C4B7'>adaptive</font></lol-uikit-tooltipped-keyword> bonus of 6 Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power.
perks.tooltip:
Start the game with 40 bonus health. When you get 4 takedowns, convert that health for an adaptive bonus of 6 Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power.

perks.name: Jack Of All Trades
perks.longDesc:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain 8 or 20 bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks, respectively.
perks.shortDesc:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks.
perks.tooltip:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain 8 or 20 bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks, respectively.

perks.name: Arcane Comet
perks.longDesc:
Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing increased damage based on distance.

Adaptive Damage: 15 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP and +0.1 bonus AD)
Cooldown: 20 - 8s

Damage amplification scales up to 100% at 750 range.
perks.shortDesc: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a damaging comet at their location.
perks.tooltip:
Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing increased damage based on how far away they are.

Damage: @DamageCalc@
Cooldown: @CooldownCalc@s

Damage amplification scales up to 100% at 750 range.

You have hit with @f3@% of comets fired, for a total of @f1@ damage to champions.

perks.name: Cash Back
perks.longDesc: Get 7.5% Gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.
perks.shortDesc: Get some gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.
perks.tooltip: Get 7.5% Gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

summoners.name: Barrier
summoners.description: Gain a brief Shield.
summoners.tooltip: Gain a <shield>{{ shieldstrength }} damage Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

summoners.name: Barrier
summoners.description: Gain a short duration shield. Summoner's Resolve: Barrier's Shield is increased.
summoners.tooltip: Gain a {{ shieldstrengthfinal }} damage Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

summoners.name: Surge
summoners.description: Temporarily empowers your champion, granting Attack Speed  and Ability Power for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Increases the Attack Speed bonus by 5% and the Ability Power bonus by 10%.
summoners.tooltip: Empowers your champion, granting {{ totalasactual }} Attack Speed and {{ totalapactual }} Ability Power for 12 seconds.

summoners.name: Cleanse
summoners.description: Removes all disables (excluding suppression and airborne) and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and gives Tenacity.
summoners.tooltip: Removes all crowd control debuffs (excluding <keyword>Suppression</keyword> and <keyword>Airborne</keyword>) and summoner spell debuffs from you and grants {{ tenacityvalue*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ tenacityduration }} seconds.

summoners.name: Cleanse
summoners.description: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and temporarily lowers the duration of incoming disables. Summoner's Resolve: Extends the Tenacity buff duration.
summoners.tooltip: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and reduces the duration of disables by 65% for the next {{ tenacitydurationfinalcalc }} seconds.

summoners.name: Flash
summoners.description: Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.
summoners.tooltip:
Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.

Cannot be cast again for one full round (a round consists of both a buy phase and a combat phase).

summoners.name: Flee
summoners.description: Gain a short burst of Move Speed, increased while running away from enemy champions.
summoners.tooltip:
Active Spell Slot: Augments that grant a Summoner Spell will replace this slot.

Gain {{ basems*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ duration }} seconds, increased by {{ bonusmsperenemybehind*100 }}% for each enemy behind you.

summoners.name: Clairvoyance
summoners.description: Reveals a small area of the map for your team for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Retain sight on units revealed by Clairvoyance for 5 seconds.
summoners.tooltip: Reveals a small area of the map for your team for 5 seconds.

summoners.name: Ignite
summoners.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration.
summoners.tooltip:
Deals {{ tooltiptruedamagecalculation }} true damage to target enemy champion over 5 seconds and applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for the duration.

Wounds: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

summoners.name: Ignite
summoners.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: While Ignite is on cooldown, gain 5 Ability Power and Attack Damage.
summoners.tooltip:
Deals {{ tooltiptruedamagecalculation }} true damage to target enemy champion over 5 seconds and applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for the duration.

Wounds: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

summoners.name: Exhaust
summoners.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their damage dealt.
summoners.tooltip: <keyword>Slows</keyword> target enemy champion by {{ slow }}% and reduces their damage dealt by {{ damagereduction }}% for {{ debuffduration }} seconds.

summoners.name: Exhaust
summoners.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their Attack Speed and damage dealt. Summoner's Wrath: Exhaust also reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 10.
summoners.tooltip: Exhausts target enemy champion, reducing their Movement Speed and Damage dealt by {{ damagereduction }}% for 2.5 seconds and reducing their Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedreduction }}% for the duration.

summoners.name: Flash
summoners.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.
summoners.tooltip: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

summoners.name: Flash
summoners.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor. Summoner's Insight: Reduces Flash's Cooldown by 15 seconds.
summoners.tooltip: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

summoners.name: Fortify
summoners.description: Grants invulnerability to all Allied Turrets and causes them to attack 100% faster for 6 seconds. Summoner's Resolve: Turrets deal splash damage around their target.
summoners.tooltip:
Passive: While Fortify is off cooldown, deal {{ bonusminiondamage }} bonus damage to minions on-hit.

Active: Grants invulnerability to all Allied Turrets and causes them to attack {{ attackspeed*100 }}% faster for {{ duration }} seconds.

summoners.name: Ghost
summoners.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration.
summoners.tooltip:
Gain {{ movespeedmod }} Move Speed and become Ghosted for {{ duration }} seconds.

Ghost: Ignore collision with other units.

summoners.name: Ghost
summoners.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Bonus Move Speed granted by Ghost is increased.
summoners.tooltip:
Gain {{ movespeedmodfinal }} Move Speed and become Ghosted for {{ duration }} seconds.

Ghost: Ignore collision with other units.

summoners.name: Heal
summoners.description: Restores Health and grants Move Speed to you and target allied champion.
summoners.tooltip:
Restores {{ totalheal }} Health and grants {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} second to you and target allied champion.

If cast without a target, it will cast on the most wounded allied champion in range.
Healing is halved on units recently affected by Summoner Heal.

summoners.name: Heal
summoners.description: Restores Health to your champion and to nearby allies. Summoner's Resolve: Gain 5 Health per level.
summoners.tooltip: Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to your champion and nearby allies.

summoners.name: Clarity
summoners.description: Restores your and ally champion's Mana.
summoners.tooltip: Restores {{ e1 }}% maximum Mana to your Champion and {{ e2 }}% to nearby allies.

summoners.name: Clarity
summoners.description: Restores your and ally champions' Mana. Summoner's Insight: Restores more mana.
summoners.tooltip: Restores {{ selfmanaactual }} Mana to your Champion and {{ allymanaactual }} max Mana to nearby allies.

summoners.name: To the King!
summoners.description: Quickly travel to the Poro King's side.
summoners.tooltip:
Passive: Hitting an enemy champion with a Poro gives your team a Poro Mark. Upon reaching 10 Poro Marks, your team summons the Poro King to fight alongside them. While the Poro King is active, no Poro Marks can be scored by either team.

Active: Quickly dash to King Poro's side. Can only be cast while the Poro King is summoned for your team.

''Poros tug the heartstrings. The rest of you just comes along for the ride.''

summoners.name: Poro Toss
summoners.description: Toss a Poro at your enemies. If it hits, you can quickly travel to your target as a follow up.
summoners.tooltip:
Toss a Poro a long distance, dealing {{ f2 }} true damage to the first enemy unit hit, granting True Sight of the target.

This ability can be recast for 3 seconds if it hits an enemy to dash to the target hit, dealing {{ f2 }} more true damage and reducing the cooldown of the next Poro Toss by {{ e4 }} seconds.

Poros are not blocked by spell shields or wind walls because they are animals, not spells!

''Poros are a model for Runeterran aerodynamics.''

summoners.name: Rally
summoners.description: Summons a temporary beacon which increases allied Attack damage in an area. Summoner's Wrath: Rally additionally gives Ability Power.
summoners.tooltip: Summons a beacon with {{ hpcalc }} Health for 15 seconds which creates an aura that increases allied Attack damage by {{ adcalc }}.

summoners.name: Revive
summoners.description: Instantly revives your champion at your team's Summoner Platform and increases their Movement Speed for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Revive temporarily grants the user 220-560 Health.
summoners.tooltip: Instantly revives your champion at your team's Summoner Platform and grants +{{ spell.summonerrevive_jade:bonusmovespeed*100 }}% Movement Speed that decays over 12 seconds.

summoners.name: Smite
summoners.description: Deals true damage to a monster or minion.
summoners.tooltip:
Deals {{ smitebasedamage }} true damage to target large monster or lane minion.

Deals {{ firstpvpdamage }} true damage to champion pets.

summoners.name: Smite
summoners.description: Deals true damage to target enemy minion or pet. Summoner's Resolve: Smite grants 10 gold per cast.
summoners.tooltip: Deals {{ smitedamage }} true damage to target enemy minion or pet.

summoners.name: Mark
summoners.description: Throw a snowball in a straight line at your enemies. If it hits an enemy, they become marked, granting True Sight, and your champion can quickly travel to the marked target as a follow up.
summoners.tooltip:
Throw a snowball a long distance, dealing {{ tooltipdamagetotal }} true damage to the first enemy unit hit and granting True Sight of the target. If it hits an enemy, this ability can be recast for {{ e3 }} seconds to Dash to the tagged unit, dealing an additional {{ tooltipdamagetotal }} true damage. Dashing to the target will reduce the cooldown of Mark by {{ e4 }}%.

Mark projectiles are not stopped by spell shields or projectile mitigation.

summoners.name: Mark
summoners.description: Throw a snowball in a straight line at your enemies. If it hits an enemy, they become marked, granting True Sight, and your champion can quickly travel to the marked target as a follow up.
summoners.tooltip:
Throw a snowball a long distance, dealing {{ tooltipdamagetotal }} true damage to the first enemy unit hit and granting True Sight of the target. If it hits an enemy, this ability can be recast for {{ e3 }} seconds to Dash to the tagged unit, dealing an additional {{ tooltipdamagetotal }} true damage. Dashing to the target will reduce the cooldown of Mark by {{ e4 }}%.

Mark projectiles are not stopped by spell shields or projectile mitigation.

summoners.name: Promote
summoners.description: Promotes a minion, granting it bonus stats, an empowering aura, and causing it to grant the caster gold for its kills. Summoner's Wrath: The Siege Rider's bonus Attack Damage aura also affects Champions.
summoners.tooltip:
Promotes an allied minion to a Siege Rider with {{ unithealth }} Health and {{ unitdamage }} Attack Damage who grants the caster gold for its kills.

The Siege Rider has an aura that provides {{ damageaura }} Attack Damage and {{ armoraura }} Armor to nearby minions.

summoners.name: Teleport
summoners.description: After a brief channel, become untargetable and travel to an allied unit. Upgrades into Unleashed Teleport, which significantly increases travel speed.
summoners.tooltip:
After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, become Untargetable and travel to target allied structure, minion, or ward.

Upgrades into Unleashed Teleport at {{ upgrademinute }} minutes, which significantly increases travel speed.

summoners.name: Teleport
summoners.description: After a short channel, your champion teleports to a target allied minion, turret, or ward. Summoner's Insight: Teleport's channel time is reduced.
summoners.tooltip: After channeling for {{ channeltimefinal }} seconds, your champion teleports to target allied minion, turret, or ward.

summoners.tooltip:
Will be replaced by your Ultimate Summoner Spell.

Gain Attack-Smite. Attack-Smite will execute allied Buff Monsters, Epic Monsters, and Scuttle Crabs when you attack them.

Attack-Smite does not have a cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
